problem_text: Choose the signs: two numbers multiply to a positive number and add to a negative number.
student_prompt: Answer this short repair question. Keep your working brief.

error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If you choose both positive, you know the product rule but not the sum-direction check. Factorising quadratics with negative middle terms depends on combining both sign clues.

hint_ladder.title: Sign meaning
hint_ladder.prompt: A positive product means the two signs are the same. A negative sum then tells you which same-sign pair is needed.

hint_ladder.title: Same signs
hint_ladder.prompt: The signs could both be positive or both be negative for a positive product. Check the sum direction next.

hint_ladder.title: Sum direction
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is stopping at same signs. If the sum is negative, both numbers need to point negative.

hint_ladder.title: Sign rule
hint_ladder.prompt: For a positive product, choose same signs; for the sum direction, choose positive or negative. Apply both checks here; do not copy.

common_errors: uses the previous larger problem instead of this repair skill
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on using the product sign without also using the sign of the sum to decide whether the pair should be positive or negative.
